15086-the-framework-of-home-rule.creator: Unknown
15086-the-framework-of-home-rule.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Since this book went to press the Treasury has issued a revised version of Return No. 220, 1911 [Revenue and Expenditure (England, Scotland, and Ireland)], cancelling the Return issued in July, and correcting an error made in it.

arxiv-2012-13702.title: A well-balanced positivity preserving cell-vertex finite volume method satisfying the discrete maximum-minimum principle for coupled models of surface water flow and scalar transport
arxiv-2012-13702.creator: Hasan Karjoun a , Abdelaziz Beljadid a,b,∗ , Philippe G. LeFloch c
arxiv-2012-13702.description: Abstract We develop a new finite volume method using unstructured mesh-vertex grids for coupled systems modeling shallow water flows and solute transport over complex bottom topography. Novel well-balanced positivity preserving discretization techniques are proposed for the water surface elevation and the concentration of the pollutant.

arxiv-2103-03810.title: Quantum study of reaction O ( P 3 {}^{3}P ) + H 2 ( v , j v,j ) → \rightarrow OH + H: OH formation in strongly UV-irradiated gas
arxiv-2103-03810.creator: A. Veselinova, M. Agúndez, J. R. Goicoechea, M. Menéndez, A. Zanchet, E. Verdasco, P. G. Jambrina, and F. J. Aoiz
arxiv-2103-03810.description: Abstract The reaction between atomic oxygen and molecular hydrogen is an important one in astrochemistry as it regulates the abundance of the hydroxyl radical and serves to open the chemistry of oxygen in diverse astronomical environments. However, the existence of a high activation barrier in the reaction with ground state oxygen atoms limits its efficiency in cold gas.

arxiv-2303-12678.title: Uni-Fusion: Universal Continuous Mapping
arxiv-2303-12678.creator: Yijun Yuan, Andreas Nüchter
arxiv-2303-12678.description: Abstract We present Uni-Fusion, a universal continuous mapping framework for surfaces, surface properties (color, infrared, etc.) and more (latent features in CLIP embedding space, etc.). We propose the first universal implicit encoding model that supports encoding of both geometry and different types of properties (RGB, infrared, features, etc.) without requiring any training.

arxiv-2305-11361.title: Group fairness without demographics using social networks Conference: 2023 ACM Conference on Fairness, Accountability, and Transparency; June 12–15, 2023; Chicago, IL, USA 2023 ACM Conference on Fairness, Accountability, and Transparency (FAccT ’23), June 12–15, 2023, Chicago, IL, USA Price: 15.00 D
arxiv-2305-11361.creator: David Liu, Virginie Do, Nicolas Usunier, Maximilian Nickel
arxiv-2305-11361.description: Abstract . Group fairness is a popular approach to prevent unfavorable treatment of individuals based on sensitive attributes such as race, gender, and disability. However, the reliance of group fairness on access to discrete group information raises several limitations and concerns, especially with regard to privacy, intersectionality, and unforeseen biases.

arxiv-2306-01226.title: Coding information into all infinite subsets of a dense set Thanks: This work was supported by the National Science Foundation under Grant DMS-2153823 and Grant DMS-2203072.
arxiv-2306-01226.creator: Matthew Harrison-Trainor, Lu Liu, Patrick Lutz
arxiv-2306-01226.description: Abstract . Suppose you have an uncomputable set X X and you want to find a set A A , all of whose infinite subsets compute X X . There are several ways to do this, but all of them seem to produce a set A A which is fairly sparse.

arxiv-2310-04758.title: Inverse transitions and disappearance of the λ \lambda - line in the asymmetric random field Ising and Blume-Capel models
arxiv-2310-04758.creator: Santanu Das 1,2, Sumedha 1,2
arxiv-2310-04758.description: Abstract We report on reentrance in the random field Ising and Blume-Capel models, induced by an asymmetric bimodal random field distribution. The conventional continuous line of transitions between the paramagnetic and ferromagnetic phases, the λ \lambda -line, is wiped away by the asymmetry.

arxiv-2402-00060.title: Treatment of Epistemic Uncertainty in Conjunction Analysis with Dempster-Shafer Theory
arxiv-2402-00060.creator: L. Sanchez and M. Vasile, S. Sanvido, K. Mertz, C. Taillan
arxiv-2402-00060.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by L. Sanchez and M. Vasile, S. Sanvido, K. Mertz, C. Taillan. The paper presents an approach to the modelling of epistemic uncertainty in Conjunction Data Messages (CDM) and the classification of conjunction events according to the confidence in the probability of collision. The approach proposed in this paper is based on Dempster-Shafer Theory (DSt) of evidence and starts from the assumption that the observed CDMs are drawn from a family of unknown distributions.

arxiv-2402-14784.title: Automated chemical reaction network generation and its application to exoplanet atmospheres EPACRIS ( Hu et al. 2012 ; Hu et al. 2013 ; Hu & Seager 2014 ; Hu 2019 ) , RMG ( Gao et al. 2016 ; Liu et al. 2021 ; Johnson et al. 2022 ; RMG 2023 )
arxiv-2402-14784.creator: Jeehyun Yang, Renyu Hu
arxiv-2402-14784.description: Abstract Along with the advent of JWST and spectroscopic characterization of exoplanet atmospheres with unprecedented detail, there is a demand for a more complete picture of chemical and photochemical reactions and their impact on atmospheric composition. Traditionally, building reaction networks for (exo)planetary atmospheres involves manually tracking relevant species and reactions, a time-consuming and error-prone process.

arxiv-2404-03412.title: RADIUM: Predicting and Repairing End-to-End Robot Failures using Gradient-Accelerated Sampling
arxiv-2404-03412.creator: Charles Dawson, Anjali Parashar, and Chuchu Fan
arxiv-2404-03412.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Charles Dawson, Anjali Parashar, and Chuchu Fan. Before autonomous systems can be deployed in safety-critical applications, we must be able to understand and verify the safety of these systems. For cases where the risk or cost of real-world testing is prohibitive, we propose a simulation-based framework for a) predicting ways in which an autonomous system is likely to fail and b) automatically adjusting the system’s design and control policy to preemptively mitigate those failures.

arxiv-2405-11494.title: Automated Coastline Extraction using Edge Detection Algorithms
arxiv-2405-11494.creator: Conor O’Sullivan, Seamus Coveney, Xavier Monteys, Soumyabrata Dev
arxiv-2405-11494.description: Abstract We analyse the effectiveness of edge detection algorithms for the purpose of automatically extracting coastlines from satellite images. Four algorithms - Canny, Sobel, Scharr and Prewitt are compared visually and using metrics. With an average SSIM of 0.8, Canny detected edges that were closest to the reference edges. However, the algorithm had difficulty distinguishing noisy edges, e.g.

arxiv-2407-04164.title: AGN STORM 2: VIII. Investigating the Narrow Absorption Lines in Mrk 817 Using HST-COS Observations
arxiv-2407-04164.creator: Maryam Dehghanian, Nahum Arav, Gerard A. Kriss, Missagh Mehdipour, Doyee Byun, Gwen Walker, Mayank Sharma, Aaron J. Barth, Misty C. Bentz, Benjamin D. Boizelle, Michael S. Brotherton, Edward M. Cackett, Elena Dalla Bontà, Gisella De Rosa, Gary J. Ferland, Carina Fian, Alexei V. Filippenko, Jonathan
arxiv-2407-04164.description: Abstract We observed the Seyfert 1 galaxy Mrk 817 during an intensive multi-wavelength reverberation mapping campaign for 16 months. Here, we examine the behavior of narrow UV absorption lines seen in HST/COS spectra, both during the campaign and in other epochs extending over 14 years.

arxiv-2510-19369.title: Mapping the twist angle dependence of quasi-Brillouin zones in doubly aligned graphene/BN heterostructures
arxiv-2510-19369.creator: J. Vallejo Bustamante*, V.-H. Nguyen, L. S. Farrar, K. Watanabe, T. Taniguchi, D. Mailly, J.-Ch. Charlier, R. Ribeiro-Palau*
arxiv-2510-19369.description: Abstract When monolayer graphene is crystallographically aligned to hexagonal boron nitride (BN), a moiré superlattice is formed, producing characteristic satellite Dirac peaks in the electronic band structure. Aligning a second BN layer to graphene creates two coexisting moiré patterns, which can interfere to produce periodic, quasi-periodic or non-periodic superlattices, depending on their relative alignment.

arxiv-2510-24448.title: Rethinking Visual Intelligence: Insights from Video Pretraining
arxiv-2510-24448.creator: Pablo Acuaviva, Aram Davtyan, Mariam Hassan, Sebastian Stapf, Ahmad Rahimi, Alexandre Alahi, Paolo Favaro
arxiv-2510-24448.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated that large-scale pretraining enables systems to adapt rapidly to new problems with little supervision in the language domain. This success, however, has not translated as effectively to the visual domain, where models, including LLMs, continue to struggle with compositional understanding, sample efficiency, and general-purpose problem-solving.

arxiv-2602-16410.title: Reintroducing the Second Player in EPR
arxiv-2602-16410.creator: Leroy Chew, Mikoláš Janota, Miroslav Olšák, Martin Suda
arxiv-2602-16410.description: Abstract In this work we investigate the computational complexity of the satisfiability problem of sub-fragments of the Bernays-Schoenfinkel class of first-order logic, also known as EPR (Effectively Propositional). While Bernays-Schoenfinkel is NEXPTIME-complete, we already can obtain fragments that are PSPACE-complete by restricting our clauses to DET-HORN or KROM.

arxiv-2604-00936.title: Portable and Secure CI/CD for COBOL: Lessons from an Industrial Migration
arxiv-2604-00936.creator: Andreas Askholm, Kenneth Johnsen, Jacopo Mauro

catholic-encyclopedia-1913-battle-abbey.creator: Edwin Burton
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-battle-abbey.description: Article 'Battle Abbey' from the Catholic Encyclopedia (1913), the 15-volume English-language reference work published 1907-1914 by Robert Appleton Company.

pmc-10601508.title: Antibody dependent cell-mediated cytotoxicity selection pressure induces diverse mechanisms of resistance
pmc-10601508.creator: David J Zahavi, Rossin Erbe, Yong-Wei Zhang, Theresa Guo, Zoe X Malchiodi, Rachael Maynard, Alexander Lekan, Rosa Gallagher, Julia Wulfkuhle, Emanuel Petricoin, Sandra A Jablonski, Elana J Fertig, Louis M Weiner
pmc-10601508.description: Targeted monoclonal antibody therapy has emerged as a powerful therapeutic strategy for cancer. However, only a minority of patients have durable responses and the development of resistance remains a major clinical obstacle. Antibody-dependent cell-mediated cytotoxicity (ADCC) represents a crucial therapeutic mechanism of action; however, few studies have explored ADCC resistance.

pmc-11603059.title: The arms race of ray-finned fish against the derepression of LTR retroelements
pmc-11603059.creator: Elisa Carotti, Edith Tittarelli, Federica Carducci, Marco Barucca, Adriana Canapa, Maria Assunta Biscotti
pmc-11603059.description: Transposable elements (TEs) are dynamic components of eukaryotic genomes that are important in speciation. Evolutionary pressure has led to the evolution of silencing mechanisms, such as the involvement of Krüppel box-associated zinc finger proteins (KRAB-ZFPs) that regulate TE transcription via TRIM28-mediated NuRD complex recruitment in sarcopterygians.

pmc-11677698.title: Contemporary Review of Minimally Invasive Mitral Valve Surgery: Current Considerations and Innovations
pmc-11677698.creator: Sharifa Alsheebani, Daniel Goubran, Benoit de Varennes, Vincent Chan
pmc-11677698.description: Minimally invasive mitral valve surgery (MIMVS) has become a well-established alternative to traditional median sternotomy at high-volume surgical centers. Advancements in surgical instruments have led to further refinement of MIMVS. However, MIMVS remains limited to select patients in select settings.

pmc-12390503.title: The Diagnostic Utility of PCR in FFPE Skin Biopsies with Inconclusive Histopathology for Suspected Cutaneous Leishmaniasis: A Pilot Study from Colombia
pmc-12390503.creator: Julio César Mantilla, Nathalia Andrea Bueno, Juan Pablo Alvarez, Maria Paula López, Martha Lucía Díaz, Daniel Moreira De Avelar, Andreza Pain Marcelino, Liliane De Fátima Antonio
pmc-12390503.description: Cutaneous Leishmaniasis (CL) is a tropical disease endemic in many regions of Latin America. Its clinical diagnosis is often supported by histopathological analysis of skin biopsies; however, parasite detection by microscopy can be challenging, particularly in chronic or pauciparasitic lesions, leading to inconclusive results.

pmc-12490234.title: ENPP1 inhibitor with ultralong drug-target residence time as an innate immune checkpoint blockade cancer therapy
pmc-12490234.creator: Songnan Wang, Randolph M. Johnson, Jacqueline A. Carozza, Daniel Fernandez, Jan Scicinski, Neil A. Verity, Rachel Mardjuki, Xujun Cao, Yingjie Guo, Jacqueline Papkoff, Nigel Ray, Lingyin Li
pmc-12490234.description: SummaryOnly one in five patients respond to immune checkpoint inhibitors, which primarily target adaptive immunity. Ectonucleotide pyrophosphatase/phophodiesterase 1 (ENPP1), the dominant hydrolase of 2′3′-cyclic-GMP-AMP (cGAMP) that suppresses downstream stimulator of interferon genes (STING) signaling, has emerged as a promising innate immunotherapy target.

pmc-12583589.title: A lightweight infrared remote sensing architecture for enhanced small target detection using improved DETR with CST modules
pmc-12583589.creator: Hongyi Duan, Jinyang Niu, Junjie Hao, Pengyue Hao, Jijiang Xu
pmc-12583589.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Infrared remote sensing (IRS) ship detection faces challenges such as low resolution and environmental interference, with issues being particularly pronounced for small targets. This study proposes a lightweight architecture based on RT-DETR, termed RT-DETR-CST: A Cross-Channel Feature Attention Network (CFAN) is constructed, which achieves channel-weighted feature fusion via residual connections to suppress invalid background channels, addressing the problem of inter-channel information imbalance in infrared images and the suppression of small-target features by background noise.

pmc-12993153.title: Analytical policy commentary: Multi-prong strategies for effective climate-resilient community-based health programming in humanitarian settings and beyond
pmc-12993153.creator: Akalewold T Gebremeskel, Mekdes Assefa, Ilja Ormel, Lillian Nyamuda, Bhanu Pratap Maurya, Salim Sohani
pmc-12993153.description: The health impacts of climate change are increasingly evident, exacerbating health inequities and disproportionately affecting at-risk populations. Delays in addressing these challenges heighten risks, particularly in low-resource and humanitarian settings. Global health advocates call for immediate action to integrate health considerations into climate policies.

pmc-13077654.title: Physical rehabilitation for older patients with acute HFpEF (REHAB-HFpEF) trial: Design and rationale
pmc-13077654.creator: Amy M. Pastva, Gordon R. Reeves, David J. Whellan, Robert J. Mentz, Haiying Chen, Alain G. Bertoni, Pamela W. Duncan, Mark A. Espeland, Shelby D. Reed, M. Benjamin Nelson, Christopher M. O’Connor, Dalane W. Kitzman
pmc-13077654.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). RationaleOlder patients hospitalized for acute decompensated heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF) experience persistently poor outcomes, including physical disability, cognitive impairment, depression, impaired health-related quality of life (HRQOL), rehospitalizations, loss of independence, and mortality. In our previous phase 2 REHAB-HF trial, an innovative physical rehabilitation intervention, delivered across three phases–inpatient, 12-week outpatient, and 3-month home-based maintenance–produced large improvements in physical function and HRQOL, with signals of reduced clinical events among patients with acute HFpEF.

pmc-13224025.title: Hint2 deficiency aggravates mitochondria-associated ferroptosis in lung ischemia-reperfusion injury
pmc-13224025.creator: Yan Liu, Zhenghaolan Zou, Ke Yi, Xiangchao Ding, Wenyang Jiang, Jianjian Yang, Tianrui Chen, Ning Li, Huiqing Lin
pmc-13224025.description: SummaryMitochondria-associated ferroptosis is critical in lung ischemia-reperfusion (LI/R) injury. This study examined the role of mitochondrial protein Hint2 in LI/R using mouse models and alveolar epithelial cells. We found that LI/R and hypoxia/reoxygenation (H/R) reduced Hint2 expression. AT2-specific Hint2 knockout exacerbated lung injury, inflammation, and ferroptosis, while promoting mitochondrial fission.

pmc-13301683.title: Comparing the acute biventricular hemodynamic effects of left bundle branch area pacing (LBBAP) and left bundle optimized cardiac resynchronization therapy (LOT-CRT)
pmc-13301683.creator: A Liew, N Wijesuriya, S Howell, F Devere, J Whitaker, S Niederer, C A Rinaldi
pmc-13301683.description: BackgroundLeft bundle branch area pacing (LBBAP) and left bundle optimized cardiac resynchronization therapy (LOT-CRT) are emerging forms of cardiac resynchronization therapy. We sought to evaluate the impact of LBBAP and LOT-CRT on left and right ventricular hemodynamics.MethodsEight patients with LBBAP underwent invasive biventricular hemodynamic testing and temporary pacing using intracardiac catheters.

pmc-13545425.title: Waking-hour movement patterns and all-cause mortality: A multi-dimensional accelerometer analysis in the UK Biobank
pmc-13545425.creator: Yutao Li, Weifeng Pan, Xiangyu Du, Hengguo Song
pmc-13545425.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). ObjectiveTo examine the independent and joint associations of time spent at each physical activity intensity level during waking hours, fragmentation, and bout accumulation patterns with all-cause mortality.MethodsWe included 94,014 UK Biobank participants with valid wrist-worn accelerometer data. Waking-hour activity was characterized by light physical activity (LPA) time, moderate-to-vigorous physical activity (MVPA) time, activity fragmentation quantified by the active-to-sedentary transition probability (ASTP), and time accumulated in short (<5 min), medium (5-10 min), and long (≥10 min) bouts.
